theorems.name: vcvtop___is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  -- The input lanes are well-formed (lanes__is_wf), so is each converted lane list (lcvtop___is_wf, via the
  -- length premise), hence every candidate in the set product, and inv_lanes_ makes each one a wf vector.
  -- Premises are picked by type (‹_›), so the proof does not depend on their order in the constructors.
  intro h hs1 hs2 hop hv hne heq
  subst heq
  cases h with
  | fun_vcvtop___case_0 Lnn_1 v_M Lnn_2 vcvtop v128_1 v128 M_0 c_1_lst c_lst_lst var_2_lst =>
    subst_vars
    exact iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes hs2
      (iswf_vcvtop_lcvtop_results (vs := var_2_lst) hs1 hs2 hop ‹_› ‹_› (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hs1 hv rfl) ‹_›) ‹_›
  | fun_vcvtop___case_1 Lnn_1 M_1 Lnn_2 M_2 vcvtop v128_1 v128 v_half c_1_lst c_lst_lst var_1_lst =>
    subst_vars
    have hcs := lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hs1 hv rfl
    exact iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes hs2
      (iswf_vcvtop_lcvtop_results (vs := var_1_lst) hs1 hs2 hop ‹_› ‹_›
        (fun c hc => hcs c (List.mem_of_mem_drop (List.mem_of_mem_take hc))) ‹_›) ‹_›
  | fun_vcvtop___case_2 Lnn_1 M_1 Lnn_2 M_2 vcvtop v128_1 v128 c_1_lst c_lst_lst var_2 var_1_lst =>
    subst_vars
    have hz : wf_lane_ Lnn_2 (Option.get! (packnum_ Lnn_2 var_2)) :=
      packnum__is_wf _ _ _ (zero_is_wf _ _ _ ‹_› rfl) ‹_› rfl
    exact iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes hs2
      (iswf_Forall_append
        (iswf_vcvtop_lcvtop_results (vs := var_1_lst) hs1 hs2 hop ‹_› ‹_› (lanes__is_wf _ _ _ hs1 hv rfl) ‹_›)
        (fun l hl => List.eq_of_mem_replicate hl ▸ iswf_Forall_cons hz (iswf_Forall_nil _))) ‹_›
  | fun_vcvtop___case_3 => exact absurd rfl hne
theorems.notes:
Proved; all 4 constructors are covered and nothing is left as sorry. Cases 0, 1 and 2 use their restored length premise; case 3 (result none) is ruled out by var_0 ≠ none.

Length premises: case_0 has (List.length var_2_lst) = (List.length c_1_lst) as premise 1 of 15. case_1 has (List.length var_1_lst) = (List.length c_1_lst) as premise 1 of 12. case_2 has (List.length var_1_lst) = (List.length c_1_lst) as premise 2 of 14, after fun_zero. In every case the result list is on the left.

Premise order: binders are named in `cases ... with`, but premises are picked by type (‹_›). The unchanged proof text also compiled against copies of fun_vcvtop__ with every constructor's premises reversed and rotated (R1.lean / R1.log).

#print axioms: convert___is_wf, demote___is_wf, extend___is_wf, inv_lanes__is_wf, lanes__is_wf, promote___is_wf, trunc_sat___is_wf, wrap___is_wf (model axioms of opaque functions, each checked to be an `axiom`), propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. No sorryAx.

Dependencies:
- From the module: lcvtop___is_wf (line 9851), zero_is_wf, packnum__is_wf, lanes__is_wf, inv_lanes__is_wf, iswf_Forall_nil, iswf_Forall_cons, iswf_Forall_append.
- From HelperPool29: iswf_Forall_setproduct, which pulls in iswf_Forall_setproduct1 and iswf_Forall_setproduct2. The assembler must place these above iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes.
- A metaprogram check (C1.lean / C1.log) found that the latest model constant reached, including through HelperPool29, is fun_vcvtop__.fun_vcvtop___case_3 at line 9973, before the theorem at 9979. So placing the helpers directly above vcvtop___is_wf works.
- I deliberately do NOT use the module's iswf_Forall₂_exists_of_mem_left. It sits at line 14508, above Step_pure_is_wf and after this theorem, so using it would need the assembler to move it.

Default values: none needed. The only Option.get! reduction is Option.get! (some v128) ⇒ v128, which does not touch the Inhabited instance. All other get! terms are passed through by rfl to lcvtop___is_wf and packnum__is_wf.

The statement was checked to be byte-identical to the module's, apart from the _probe suffix.

helpers.name: iswf_vcvtop_lcvtop_results
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vcvtop_lcvtop_results {sh1 sh2 : shape} {op : vcvtop__}
    {vs : List (Option (List lane_))} {cs : List lane_}
    (hs1 : wf_shape sh1) (hs2 : wf_shape sh2) (hop : wf_vcvtop__ sh1 sh2 op)
    (hlen : vs.length = cs.length) (hF : Forall₂ (fun v c => fun_lcvtop__ sh1 sh2 op c v) vs cs)
    (hcs : Forall (fun c => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype sh1) c) cs) (hne : Forall (fun v => v ≠ none) vs) :
    Forall (fun l => Forall (fun x => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype sh2) x) l) (Map (fun v => Option.get! v) vs) := by
  intro l hl
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hl
  -- `Forall₂` is zip-based; the length premise makes every `v ∈ vs` the left part of a zipped pair.
  have hvz : v ∈ (vs.zip cs).map Prod.fst := by
    rwa [List.map_fst_zip (Nat.le_of_eq hlen)]
  obtain ⟨⟨v', c⟩, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hvz
  obtain ⟨hv', hc⟩ := List.of_mem_zip ht
  exact lcvtop___is_wf sh1 sh2 op c _ v' (hF _ ht) hs1 hs2 hop (hcs c hc) (hne v' hv') rfl

helpers.name: iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_vcvtop_wf_of_contains_inv_lanes {sh : shape} {lls : List (List lane_)} {v : vec_}
    (hsh : wf_shape sh) (h : Forall (fun l => Forall (fun x => wf_lane_ (fun_lanetype sh) x) l) lls)
    (hc : List.contains (Map (fun l => inv_lanes_ sh l) (setproduct_ lane_ lls)) v) : wf_uN 128 v := by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.contains_iff_mem.mp hc)
  exact inv_lanes__is_wf sh l _ hsh (iswf_Forall_setproduct lls h l hl) rfl

model_issue.summary: No model issue. All three result-producing constructors of fun_vcvtop__ (case_0, case_1, case_2) now carry the length premise (List.length results) = (List.length c_1_lst). Together with the zip-based Forall₂, it pairs every lcvtop result with an input lane, so lcvtop___is_wf applies to each one. The none constructor (case_3) is excluded by var_0 ≠ none. With the premises restored, the three cases blocked in the previous model (witness g4-vector-b/E1.lean) are now proved. No MODEL_ISSUE.md was written.
